messages:
andrea: Heads-up — noticed a 2.2x p95 regression for Mixtral MoE requests on the canary after the kernel-selector bump. Traces point to a new slow-path in the GPU kernel selector.

jamie: Ugh. Which selector bump? the heuristic that prefers fused softmax-gemm kernel for short sequences?

andrea: Yeah that one. Canary graph: p50 unchanged, but p95/p99 spikes for request patterns with many tiny seqs (<=32) and high expert fanout.

kai: I pulled a perf trace (pprof + nvprof) — selector is picking the "fused-v2" path but falling back mid-exec to the generic kernel for certain expert shards. Fallbacks add ~1.8ms per token due to memcpy + config patch.

marta: Repro steps? I can run a micro-benchmark locally.

andrea: Repro gist: run mixtral_moe_infer --batch_size 8 --seq_len 16 --top_k 4 --router_temp 1.0 --expert_parallelism 2 (we used our canary config). I pushed a trace to the infra bucket: gs://redwood-perf/canary/2405612345-traces.tar.gz

jamie: Noted. Curious — did RoPE scaling or head/kv dim changes land recently? Those can change tile shapes and make the fused kernel ineligible.

kai: There was an unrelated RoPE fix in the model-conversions PR (qwen/llama compat) but it was guarded. However the kernel-selector PR added an extra constraint: requires head_dim % 32 == 0 for fused-v2. Mixtral head_dim is 96, so that's fine, but when expert sharding happens we end up with 48 per-device and the selector sees 48 and flips fallback.

andrea: Aha — so expert_parallelism + device sharding reduces effective head dim -> mismatch with fused kernel assumptions. That explains the intermittent fallbacks only under MoE routing.

marta: Running the micro-bench now. Quick ask — can we try toggling router_softfill_threshold or decreasing top_k to see impact on fallback frequency?

kai: Quick experiment: lowering top_k from 8->4 reduces cross-device expert handoffs by ~30% in our sim and drops fallback counts. Also increasing selector's permissiveness for head_dim=48 in fused-v2 avoids the memcpy path but needs validation for numerical parity.

jamie: If we change selector to accept 48, we should run a small regression suite: 1) logits parity on toy prompts, 2) end-to-end latency + cost, 3) GPU memory checks (no unexpected spills). I'll take parity.

sam: Deploy-bot: Canary group 3 is currently on kernel-selector v1.14. Rolling back to v1.13 is an option if we need immediate mitigation. Want me to schedule? :robot_face:

andrea: Let's hold rollback for now. Short plan: (1) marta/kai run microbench with top_k=4 and router_temp=0.9 to see fallback counts; (2) jamie run numerical parity for fused-v2 when head_dim==48; (3) if parity OK, flip selector guard to accept 48; (4) keep canary and observe 24h. If parity fails or rolling regressions, sam to rollback. Owning: marta(1), jamie(2), kai(3), sam(4).

marta: Starting run now. I'll push results in ~20m.

kai: Also putting a short-term metric alert: router_fallback_rate and per-expert memcpy_us. If memcpy_us>0.5ms and fallback_rate>1% we trigger an incident channel ping.

jamie: I'll queue the parity tests. If parity is off by tiny eps, we might consider a numerics-tolerant switch with a feature flag.

andrea: Thanks all. If anyone finds a quick mitigation (batching heuristic tweak, or router affinity change) drop it here. Otherwise we'll reconvene after marta's run.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout paused at group 3 due to manual hold (andrea).

marta: Results: with top_k=4 + router_temp=0.9 fallback_count down 68%, p95 back to baseline in canary sim. Uploading perf logs to the same bucket: gs://redwood-perf/canary/2405612345/results.json

andrea: Nice. jamie, any blockers on parity?

jamie: Parity script ran. Max relative diff in logits < 3e-6 across 100 prompts. No obvious divergence. Memory profiles look clean. I'm OK to proceed with selector change behind a feature flag.

kai: I'll open a PR to relax the fused-v2 guard and add a runtime flag to enable for head_dim==48. Also adding a metrics tag so we can A/B compare. PR: https://git.redwood/repo/runtime/pulls/4871

sam: If PR lands, I'll coordinate a controlled canary rollout and pre-create rollback playbook.

andrea: Great. Moving to action. Closing loop after 24h observation. :thumbsup:
